t: You are looking at the Chapel of St Luke, part of the Royal Brompton Hospital, which counts as a Grade II star listed Anglican church in Chelsea. It was built in 1849. The architect was Edward Buckton Lamb, who was labelled a Rogue Gothic Revivalist. The Ecclesiologist roundly criticised his designs for breaking with convention. Nikolaus Pevsner, though, called him the most original, though certainly not the most accomplished, architect of his day. That makes this a good building to look at closely for yourself.
